pages.title: Email ingestion
pages._note: The emails filed from watched inbox folders into their dossiers, and the files that could not be filed, with the reason (email-ingestion). type:custom because it reads GET api/email-ingestion, which serves admins only, and its re-scan and convert-again actions are filinq endpoints, not object operations.

pages.title: Intake
pages._note: The inbox between a channel and a record. type:custom rather than type:index because the two verbs on a waiting document, assign and reject, both write through filinq's own endpoints: assigning checks write rights on BOTH the intake schema and the record the clerk aims at, which a declarative object-op cannot express.

pages.title: Classification suggestions
pages._note: The document type, sender and dossier suggestions waiting for a person (inbound-auto-classification). type:custom because the list is filtered on the caller's own access to each file and confirm/reject are filinq endpoints that write the document and move the file, not object operations.
